results.title: Haley Stevens in ‘house divided’ over El-Sayed
results.description: Michigan Democratic Rep. Haley Stevens reaffirmed her support for Democratic Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed after The Detroit News reported her fiancé said he’s voting for Republican candidate Mike Rogers in the state’s high-stakes Senate race.

results.title: Alabama transportation officials urge extra caution for Halloween trick-or-treating
results.description: With Halloween approaching, Alabama officials remind parents to ensure children's safety while trick-or-treating. Tips include using reflective gear, walking with kids, and practicing road safety to avoid pedestrian accidents.

results.title: GOP Rep. Dan Phelan on how Talarico’s ‘Pass on Paxton’ ad could impact the senate race
results.description: A brutal new video released by the TX Senate Democratic nominee James Talarico’s campaign features several Republicans who say they won’t back his Republican opponent, Ken Paxton.

results.title: University of Chicago students, staff rally over reported sexual assaults near campus, demand action
results.description: Students and staff at the University of Chicago rallied on the main quad in response to two reported sexual assaults involving fraternities near campus, calling on the university to address a list of demands by Nov. 20.

results.title: Trump's border: quiet, but few people are happy
results.description: On the eve of the midterm elections, this arid region in the Southwest serves as proof that Donald Trump kept his central campaign promise: to restore order at the border.
